page.overview:
Who is Ivory Rook?

Ivory Rook is a Crystal Earth pony stallion with a light yellow coat, blue mane and tail, light blue eyes, and a cutie mark of a crenelated tower. He is unnamed in the show, but he is named in merchandise.__TOC__

Ivory Rook shares his design with Bright Smile, "Rubinstein", Rook Ramparts, "Zirconic", "Sugar Glass", "Check Mate", "Crystal Varado", and S03E02 Unnamed Earth Stallion #1.

Ivory Rook first appears in The Crystal Empire - Part 1 during Princess Celestia's flashback of the Crystal Empire, shown to be in the forced servitude of King Sombra. Later in the episode, he is one of many Crystal Ponies having become depressed as a result of King Sombra's curse. Hearing news of the Crystal Faire lifts his spirits and returns color to his coat and mane.

In The Crystal Empire - Part 2, Ivory Rook has other forms of fun at the Crystal Faire, like enjoying the petting zoo and watching Rainbow Dash and Fluttershy's jousting match. He helps power the Crystal Heart at the end of the episode.
